prompt: An action logs diagnostic detail through debug commands, but users report seeing nothing. Why?
explanation: Debug lines are emitted always but displayed only when the run re-runs with debug logging enabled (or the `ACTIONS_STEP_DEBUG` secret is set). That is the design: verbose diagnostics stay out of the way until someone asks for them.

options.text: Debug output requires debug logging to be enabled for the run
Debug commands only work in Docker actions
The runner strips debug lines from composite actions
Debug output is reserved for GitHub’s own actions
